It is Turn 6 Main Phase 1. Your set cards were set on previous turns. Your Stardust was summoned by Starlight Road and was not properly Synchro Summoned.

checkpoints.rationale: Lyla activates an effect that would destroy a card; Stardust can negate that activation by Tributing itself as cost, without targeting. Being summoned by Starlight Road does not prevent the negation effect but prevents its later GY Special Summon because it was not properly summoned. Resolution and revival are outside this test. This reviewed goal deliberately need not imitate the recorded human pass.
evidence: Original immutable rules.md, Stardust Dragon and Lyla descriptions, and revision 88 saved decision packet.
